notes: CORRECTIONS: change a receipt's or bill's date, number or cheque number after it is issued; a receipt recorded as cash that was really a cheque (or the other way round) is switched. BILL NUMBERING: enter found bills with their exact paper number while the books are cleaned, then switch to automatic numbering. BILLS TO CHECK: bill numbers in the books more than once, To rectify and Settled, each copy can be put right. HOME shows cheques dated months from their receipt and bills without a revenue centre. RESTORE shows what a backup is missing before you go ahead. BACKUPS: each computer keeps its own backup folder. Receipts and invoices have a filing margin. Update the main computer first and take a backup first: Setup, Backup, Back up now. No upgrade of the books: backups move freely between 1.7.0 and 1.8.0.
